scope: Final encoded media, editable audio source, published documentation and existing verification evidence. This report is added before final packaging; the publisher must recheck the completed ZIP and publication manifest after incorporating it. No mutable ZIP or manifest hashes are frozen here.

voice.note: Single-call and single-result provenance is declared by the generator and cue record. No ASR or subjective listening claim.

fresh_encoded_mix_checks.method: Re-ran the distributed verify-render-audio.py against unchanged published media in a scratch project. Re-ran verify-voice.py there as well, preserving public evidence files.

limits: Naturalness, energy, transcription accuracy and intelligibility are not certified by signal checks; no listening or ASR review is claimed.
The audio checker verifies voice/music identity, timing, level and changing effect references, not an independently reconstructed processed music stem.
The final completed ZIP and manifest require the publisher’s post-review integrity check.
Instagram app overlays, upload and recompression were not tested. No Instagram post was made.
This controlled demo does not count toward independent maintainer pilot installations.
